summary: Unmaintained collections community.azure, gluster.gluster, hpe.nimble, netapp.aws, netapp.azure, netapp.elementsw and netapp.um_info were removed from Ansible 10 but can still be installed with ansible-galaxy. community.sap was renamed to community.sap_libs, and purestorage.fusion was removed.
questions: How do I keep using gluster.gluster after upgrading to Ansible 10?
Why did my community.azure modules disappear?

answer_card.title: Getting removed collections back
answer_card.answer_md:
These were removed from the Ansible 10 package as unmaintained but can still be installed manually: `community.azure`, `gluster.gluster`, `hpe.nimble`, `netapp.aws`, `netapp.azure`, `netapp.elementsw`, `netapp.um_info`.

```shell
ansible-galaxy collection install gluster.gluster
```

`community.sap` is now `community.sap_libs`, so update your FQCNs. `purestorage.fusion` was removed.
